The memo visibility enforcement in server surfaces occurs at the following locations:

1. API V1 Memo Service (GetMemo/ListMemos read access) — /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
2. API V1 Reaction Service (ListMemoReactions/UpsertMemoReaction) — /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go
3. API V1 Attachment Service (GetAttachment access for linked attachments) — /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go
4. File Server (serveAttachmentFile permission check) — /bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go
5. API V1 Memo Comments Service (CreateMemoComment/ListMemoComments) — /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go
6. API V1 Memo Attachment Service (ListMemoAttachments) — /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go
7. RSS Service (GetExploreRSS/GetUserRSS visibility filtering) — /bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go
